issues.description: The required Stock API is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML specifies a method named emptyStock(), but the template Stock class provides clearInventory() instead (and the reference solution implements emptyStock()). Students starting from the template may implement/override the wrong method name and tests expecting emptyStock() will fail.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, rename clearInventory() to emptyStock() (same behavior) or add an emptyStock() method that delegates to clearInventory(); ensure the required API and starter code use the same name.

issues.description: The problem statement is internally inconsistent about whether SealSaloon.stock is static/shared: the UML association depicts stock as an instance attribute, but the textual requirements explicitly state the stock attribute (and related methods) must be static and shared across all SealSaloon instances. This contradiction can mislead students when declaring the field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML match the text by marking stock as {static} (e.g., underline the attribute or add a {static} stereotype) or adjust the text if stock is intended to be per-instance; ensure both sources agree.
